content:
The green annuli have inner radii \(k=1,3,\ldots,99\).

\[
\sum_{\substack{k=1\\ k\text{ odd}}}^{99}(2k+1)
=2(1+3+\cdots+99)+50
=2(50^2)+50
=5050.
\]

The area of the circle of radius 100 is \(\pi(100^2)\), so the ratio is

\[
\frac{5050\pi}{10000\pi}=\frac{5050}{10000}=\frac{101}{200}.
\]

Thus \(m+n=101+200=\boxed{301}\).
